name: MalShare (malware sample repository API)
tier_rationale: Long-running community malware repository with an identifiable project, public API documentation and free researcher keys (A8 community): 'Registry tiers: Recorded Future, OPSWAT and PolySwarm trusted; MalShare and VirusShare community.' (P177 cond 6).

reliability.justification: Repository membership says a sample was collected from a malware distribution source, not which family it is: presence is a hint, never a verdict alone; one vote per adapter (P177 cond 5).

malshare.description: MalShare API key (api_key URL parameter, masked by the central redactor)
malshare.plan_hint: free researcher key with a daily request limit (action=getlimit reports LIMIT/REMAINING); terms 'unknown' until legal records them (P177 cond 4), so the source stays disabled in every profile; an empty or placeholder key is never used

api.title: MalShare API (action=details hash metadata only)

terms.quote: Classes: triage free 'noncommercial' (commercial licence 'license'); metadefender free 'noncommercial' (paid plan 'key-terms'); malshare, polyswarm and virusshare 'unknown' until legal records their terms.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P177 cond 4). Research C0415 (verified_needs_key: no key -> 400 'No key specified in `api_key` GET variable'). https://malshare.com/api.php?api_key={KEY}&action=details&hash={md5|sha1|sha256}; only the actions details and getlimit are ever built (P177 cond 2: never getfile, upload, download_url or the list/search actions). Errors come back as plain text, also inside HTTP 200: the module reads them (no key / invalid key -> NEEDS_KEY, request limit -> QUOTA, 'not found' -> EMPTY, anything else -> ERROR). Daily quota: start at 1000 requests (not published; getlimit gives the key's real LIMIT). Batch p3-G07-2, module malshare.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-2 (P177, module malshare). Terms 'unknown': disabled in every profile until legal records them; default_enabled False. Search/metadata only: no sample download or submission path is ever built.
